interpretation_guards: This tests revisit spacing/order over identical optimizer windows, not raw dose.
Do not call it currentness drift; the environment is stationary.
Do not interpret optimizer momentum/path effects as nuisance: they are part of developmental temporal topology, but remain optimizer-mediated in this learner.
A positive result does not establish a universal spacing law.
No adaptive schedule changes after launch.

MASSED_REVISIT_SUPPORTED: massed false-side mean not worse than spaced by >0.05
massed true-side mean not worse than spaced by >0.05
REVISIT_TOPOLOGY_NOT_SUPPORTED: absolute mean paired balanced_accuracy delta <=0.01 AND neither arm wins >=4/6
STRUCTURED_REVISIT_SUPPORTED: spaced false-side mean not worse than massed by >0.05
spaced true-side mean not worse than massed by >0.05
